decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be installed to be flush with the existing roof slope and have a 'conservation style' with a central mullion.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the ground floor extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The application for the erection of single storey rear extension, erection of two rear roof extensions with roof windows to front and side of house, as shown on drawing numbers 060/A002, 060/A003 & 060/A004, Received 2 October 2006; and 060/A010 & 060/A011, received 21 November 2006 is recommended for approval as by reason of its size, position and appearance, it would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties and would preserve and enhance the appearance and character of Grove Park Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and two rear roof extensions with roof windows to front and side of house
